about_short_description.short_description: SmartWTI is a provider of Internet of Things and AI solutions that specializes in creating and manufacturing water management solutions.

product.name: Smart WTI-Water Management Solution
product.description: A system that helps individuals and organizations conserve and manage water by tracking and controlling water consumption and quality, and predicting water consumption using AI algorithms.

product.name: AI/IoT Cloud-solution
product.description: A cloud-based solution for remote equipment monitoring, controlling, and management of water and other liquids using web and mobile applications.

product.name: Sensors
product.description: Various sensors for measuring parameters such as dissolved oxygen, temperature, pH, ORP, conductivity, salinity, turbidity, suspended solids, COD, BOD, TOC, SAC254, radar level, temperature, humidity, pressure, luminosity, and ultrasound.

product.name: Accessories
product.description: Additional components like GPS modules, Li-ion rechargeable and non-rechargeable batteries, and rigid solar panels.

identifier.value: Applications of IoT for Water & Other Liquids Management

product.name: Applications of IoT for Water & Other Liquids Management
product.description: Solutions for metering, monitoring, and controlling water and oil storage, leak detection, truck management, industrial water management, irrigation, water quality monitoring, wastewater control, water distribution network management, swimming pool measurement, fish farm management, and hydroponics and aquarium management.
